independentChecks.name: harness_defect_classification
independentChecks.details: The same run recorded uv_version=uv 0.11.8 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) in task-oss-09-diagnostics.txt, while the workflow step asserts test "$(uv --version)" = "uv 0.11.8". phase-markers.txt stops before after-task-oss-09-runtime-version-checks and phase-failure.txt records lastPhase=before-task-oss-09-runtime-version-checks with exitCode=1. That proves the failure is the harness's brittle exact-string assertion, not a task READY failure. This review does not claim why uv emitted the suffix or that the formatting is stable beyond this run.

independentChecks.name: claim_boundary
independentChecks.details: The attempt-3 evidence stays within a conservative boundary: one failed measured dispatch, no rerun, no READY receipt, no offline proof, and no aggregate qualification. The HARNESS_DEFECT claim is confined to the verified exact-string mismatch in the runtime-version-check phase.

minimalMitigation.recommendedChange: Replace the exact uv output assertion with a version-aware match that tolerates the observed platform suffix, for example verifying that uv --version begins with "uv 0.11.8" while still preserving the pinned version requirement.
minimalMitigation.expectedRiskReduction: Removes a harness-only false negative at the runtime-version-check gate without expanding the READY boundary or weakening later task/install/test/offline requirements.

unverifiedLimits: This review does not prove whether uv will always include the platform suffix on future runners.
This review does not classify any behavior after the runtime-version-check gate because uv sync, pytest, cache generation, offline verification, and aggregation were not reached for TASK-OSS-09.
This review does not claim any cache READY, receipt completeness, offline proof, aggregate qualification, or benchmark success.
residualRisk: After the harness assertion is fixed, a later TASK-OSS-09 failure could still appear in uv sync, uv.lock immutability, pytest, or subsequent cache-generation phases.
TASK-OSS-01 and TASK-OSS-03 remain unqualified because fail-fast cancelled them before offline verification.
